text.es: Me he despertado y no estabas a mi lado. No he podido evitar estremecerme al pensar que todo había sido un sueño. De repente has entrado por la puerta, aún desnuda. Te has tumbado a mi lado apoyando tu cabeza en mi pecho. Es entonces cuando he pedido a Dios no despertarme nunca. Eres mi sueño eterno, Fina.
text.en: I woke up and you weren't beside me. I couldn't help shuddering at the thought that it had all been a dream. Suddenly you came through the door, still naked. You laid down beside me, resting your head on my chest. It was then that I asked God never to wake me up. You are my eternal dream, Fina.
